preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some LuffyInu tokens to sell
Attacker must NOT be the owner and NOT be in excludeFee mapping

exploit_hint: The contract deducts liquidity fees but doesn't add them to the pair's reserves. When selling tokens to the pair, the liquidity fee is transferred to the pair address but not added to reserves, creating an imbalance. Attack by: 1. Ensure taxStatus is true, 2. Sell tokens to the uniswapV2Pair, 3. The liquidity fee (1%) is sent to pair address but not added to reserves, 4. This creates an arbitrage opportunity where you can buy back tokens at a discount since reserves don't reflect the actual token balance.
